title: Admin Password Rotation & Session Revocation API Contract
description: API endpoints for administrator self-service password rotation, timing-safe verification, sliding-window rate limiting, and global session tokenVersion invalidation.

endpoints.description: Rotate logged-in administrator password, increment tokenVersion, and invalidate sessions on secondary devices.

currentPassword.description: Existing plaintext password for timing-safe verification

newPassword.description: New password, minimum 8 characters with letters and numbers
